bullets.bullet_text: Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing engagements by structuring traceable scenarios, challenger model variants, and model-risk remediation, producing governance-grade evidence trusted by regulated financial institutions.

Architected enterprise risk-management operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics to give stakeholders a defensible, repeatable framework.

Directed quantitative derivatives and insurance-capital initiatives spanning exotic pricing, liability Greek hedging, and higher-order stress testing, translating complex risk mechanics into defensible hedge design for regulated clients.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, stress testing, and model-validation work by structuring traceable scenarios, challenger variants, model-risk remediation, and governance evidence for regulated financial institutions.
Architected ERM operating models and BCBS 239-aligned risk-data aggregation by defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics.
Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital work using exotic pricing, liability Greeks, higher-order stress testing, and hedge design.
